ik_options.source: Kinematics.solveIK defaults; the dry-run passes an empty options object

seed_policy: frame 0 uses UR5 initial joints; each later frame uses the previous formal solution
alignment_policy: Compute T_align = S_0 × inverse(D_0) once; apply Target_i = T_align × D_i to every frame

alignment.definition: T_align = S_0 × inverse(D_0); Target_i = T_align × D_i

failure_diagnostic_thresholds.method: diagnostic only: max(20 mm or 3× episode median translation, 0.15 rad or 3× median rotation)
